verdict.rationale: Make documents a REST public API and an official MCP server that gives AI clients scenario 'management' tools and lets agents 'view and modify scenarios,' so an agent can programmatically update workflows. However, the pack contains no scenario API reference showing create, update, or activate endpoints. Missing for 10: documented scenario create endpoint, documented activate/deactivate endpoint, scenario-specific API reference, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API

citations.quote: View and modify scenarios and their related entities (e.g., connections, webhooks, and data stores)
Make MCP server allows AI systems, such as large language models (LLMs), to run scenarios and manage the contents of your Make account.
The server provides them access to **scenario run** and **management** tools
The Make API follows the REST API design. Make API is organized into resource-oriented URLs
